about.description: mrcUSD (Mobile rcUSD) is the receipt coin of Ember's R25 Treasury vault on Sui. Deposits are USDC and the vault's backing is held as rcUSDp - the sub-account holds 7,456,999.92 rcUSDp, 97% of supply - so this is a wrapper over R25 paper and must not be counted alongside rcUSD/rcUSDp. Price = USDC x 1/vault rate, served by the ember coins adapter since 2025-12-18. The vault rate is admin-set (max 1% per update, 12h interval) and as of 2026-10-19 marks ~5% above the on-chain backing, implying rcUSD at $1.0536 against its stated $1 peg.
about.registryInfo: Ember operates the R25 Treasury vault on Sui (0x6013f760aa089ef027e9b92f7c09edf5fef73ef6b48fc5ecd8af62a4ef2db3d8) with R25 as strategy manager; the two appear as co-managers on the vault's sub-accounts.
